description: Every threshold that can change an answer. Hashed into provenance.

carryover_alpha.description: Switchback designs: level of the carryover check (the effect still moving after the washout, into- vs out-of-treatment switches). A failure makes the result contested. Looser than refutation_alpha on purpose: a missed carryover leaves a biased estimate supported (T8 v2).
carryover_alpha.title: Carryover Alpha

cs_burn_in.description: Sequential designs: units before the first look. The sequence is asymptotic; below this it is not reported.
cs_burn_in.title: Cs Burn In

cs_target_n.description: Sequential designs: the sample size the confidence sequence is tightest at.
cs_target_n.title: Cs Target N

limited_overlap_bounds.description: Propensities outside these bounds (Crump et al. 2009) count toward the limited-overlap flag, set when their share exceeds max_extreme_propensity_share. The flag warns; it does not refuse or change the estimate.
limited_overlap_bounds.title: Limited Overlap Bounds

match_caliper.description: Rosenbaum bound: the matched design's caliper, in standard deviations of the propensity-score logit (Austin 2011). Units with no partner inside it are dropped.
match_caliper.title: Match Caliper

max_cluster_size_cv.description: Cluster-randomized designs: above this coefficient of variation of cluster sizes, a few large clusters dominate the estimate and its interval under-covers (T7 v2: 0.879 at CV 0.71); the analysis refuses.
max_cluster_size_cv.title: Max Cluster Size Cv

min_clusters_per_arm.description: Cluster-randomized designs: fewer clusters than this in either arm and the cluster-level variance cannot be estimated; the analysis refuses.
min_clusters_per_arm.title: Min Clusters Per Arm

overlap_region_alpha.description: One-sided level of the Clopper-Pearson bound in the overlap-region check.
overlap_region_alpha.title: Overlap Region Alpha

overlap_region_bound.description: Binary treatments with an adjustment set: a covariate region is a positivity violation for an arm when the upper confidence bound on that arm's probability there, from held-out units, is below this. 0 turns the region check off. A violation share above max_extreme_propensity_share refuses; a smaller one is warned about (T10).
overlap_region_bound.title: Overlap Region Bound

overlap_region_depth.description: Depth of the tree whose leaves are the candidate regions: the most covariates a region can be defined by jointly.
overlap_region_depth.title: Overlap Region Depth

pt_sensitivity_grid.description: Panel designs: multiples of the largest pre-adoption deviation at which to report parallel-trends-robust intervals.
pt_sensitivity_grid.title: Pt Sensitivity Grid

segment_alpha.description: Level for the heterogeneity test across declared segments. Looser than the refutation alphas on purpose: this test decides whether segments may be compared at all, and missing real heterogeneity is the costlier error.
segment_alpha.title: Segment Alpha
